name: Pitchside
description: A single-file H5 league app with two tables over one set of facts. The real table is not stored: it is folded out of sixteen results every time it is read — three for a win, one for a draw, then goal difference, then goals scored, then the name. The second table is the same fold with your predictions for the coming round mixed in, so you can see what a result would do to the standings without anything having happened, and clearing the predictions puts it back. 6 screens, 8 clubs, 16 results, 4 fixtures to guess at.

finish.answer: final answer for question tasks; optional for action tasks

observation.text: engine.a11y(state) — both tables serialise row by row with played, goal difference and points, and the what-if table marks which clubs moved.
observation.pixels: 390x844 screenshot (browser backend); __ENV__.bounds() maps every test-id to a pixel box
observation.state: engine.snapshot(state) — canonical state plus a derived view keyed by club name. For the verifier only.

world.table: 3 points a win, 1 a draw; ordered by points, then goal difference, then goals scored, then name
world.predictions: a home win is 2-0, a draw 1-1, an away win 0-2; they only ever affect the second table
world.standings: Larkfield lead on 10 points from Fenwold on 9, level on goal difference and split by goals scored
